written_before: any round-2 fine-tune or blind test
weights_reason: four tasks weighted equally; set by the user before round 2 (round 1 used 40/20/20/20)

architecture.note: learned pulses + pitch reference act only while the nod/dash command is on and for tail_s after it drops; otherwise reflex PID + base_law pulse law run exactly as bench.Classical(law). Hover and upset are therefore identical to the classical controller base_law (ratio 1.0 when base_law is the task opponent).

training.objective: mean ratio over nod and dash on fresh training cases
training.start: round-1 imitation spec of the same seed

hypotheses.H1: composite (25/25/25/25) <= 0.95 in >= 2 of 3 seeds AND T1 ratio <= 1.05 (T1 is 1.0 by construction when base_law = law_tuned)
hypotheses.H1_prime: non-inferiority + superiority: every task ratio <= 1.05 AND at least one of T2/T3 <= 0.90 with paired sign-test p < 0.05, in >= 2 of 3 seeds
hypotheses.H2: >= 2 of T2, T3, T4 <= 0.90 in >= 2 of 3 seeds (T4 is 1.0 by construction unless base_law = pulse_tuned, then T1 moves instead)
hypotheses.H3: ablations (clamp_fast, nodelay_all, noref, nopulse) raise the composite by >= 10 % or silence the pulses
hypotheses.H4: ANN of the same size through the same gated pipeline matches the SNN (no SNN performance claim)
hypotheses.secondary: per-case median ratio and paired win fraction are reported next to the mean ratio for every task (the nod mean is dominated by single misses)

amendment_1.what: righting reflex in layer 2: when the learned layer is not in charge and the AHRS tilt exceeds 25.0 deg, the reflex pulse law switches (latched for the episode) from base_law to the upset-tuned pulse law (pulse_tuned). Both laws are the classical, hand-tuned pieces of round 1.
amendment_1.why: with a single base_law the upset task is 1.13 by construction (law_tuned vs pulse_tuned), a penalty unrelated to the learned layer. Measured on the blind sets with the imitation spec before this amendment: tilt 15 deg -> upset 1.028 but hover 1.140 (triggers in hover); 25 deg -> upset 1.050, hover 1.000; 35 deg -> 1.095/1.000; 45 deg -> 1.128/1.000; 60 deg -> 1.130/1.000. 25 deg chosen.
amendment_1.consequence: hover stays 1.000 by construction; upset is ~1.05 (at the non-inferiority margin), not 1.0.

amendment_2.written_before: the round-2 blind test of seed 2 (MACPC, still running); AFTER the blind tests of seeds 1 (0.940) and 3 (1.114)
amendment_2.what: model selection uses a larger validation set and a zero-crash constraint: 8 validation cases per task (nod, dash; 16 in total; the first 4 per task are the original validation cases, the next 4 are drawn from the same train-split generator, offset COLLECT_OFFSET['val']+10_000, i = 4..7) and the selected centre is the lowest validation composite among the saved validated centres (spec_val_g*.json, every 5 generations) with zero crashes on the 16 cases. The ES search itself is unchanged: validation never enters the ES update, so re-selecting among the saved centres of the existing round-2 runs is equivalent to re-running them under the new rule (up to the checkpoint-resume reseed of seed 1 at generation 20). The selected centre gets one blind test (intact + ablations) on the unchanged blind sets. Implemented in reselect_r2.py; selection on CloudPC (Linux) for every seed.
amendment_2.why: seed 3's 8-case validation never showed a crash, but its selected centre (gen 49) crashed in 4/16 blind dash cases (tilt termination; peak tilt 51 deg vs 37 deg for seed 1): the two seeds reached the same dash speed by different strategies (large pitch reference vs more pulses) and the 8-case set could not tell the fragile one apart. Centres at generations 29, 34 and 59 of seed 3 crash on the added cases.
amendment_2.disclosure: an exploratory run of exactly this rule on seed 3 was done BEFORE this amendment was written (reselect_r2_s3.json: picks gen 54, blind composite 0.958, dash 16/16). That number is therefore not blind with respect to the choice of the rule; the rule's parameters (8 per task, zero crashes) were fixed in the proposal to the user before that run and were not tuned on its outcome. Seeds 1 and 2 are evaluated under the rule without any prior look.
amendment_2.reporting: the paper reports both selections for every seed: the original round-2 rule (4 per task, lowest composite) and amendment 2; H1/H1' are judged on the amendment-2 selection, with the original listed alongside. Thresholds are unchanged.
amendment_2.extension_seeds: if seeds 4 and 5 are added later they will be declared before their imitation training starts and H1/H1' will then require >= 3 of 5 seeds.

amendment_3.written_before: any result of the CloudPC seed-3 search (and before the HomePC seed-2 search finishes)
amendment_3.what: seed 3's round-2 ES search is repeated on CloudPC (the machine on which every selection and blind test is run), same seed, same settings (60 generations, 30 workers); the HomePC search is kept and reported. Likewise seed 2's search moved from the Mac to HomePC (Linux); the Mac run is archive-only.
amendment_3.why: the saved centres of the HomePC seed-3 search are numerically unstable across machines (gen 49: validation 0.805 on HomePC vs 0.918 on CloudPC; gen 54: 0.807 vs 0.810), so search and selection on different machines evaluate different behaviours of the same weights. Seed 1 was searched and selected on CloudPC; the Mac differs from Linux even more (seed 2 blind 0.981 with upset 1.054 instead of 1.050).
amendment_3.rule: for every seed the primary run for the H1/H1' tally is the run searched on CloudPC when one exists (seed 1, seed 3 replicate); seed 2 (HomePC search) has no CloudPC replicate and its HomePC run is primary. Selection by amendment 2 (16 validation cases, zero crashes), one blind test per selected centre. The HomePC seed-3 results (original rule 1.114, amendment 2 0.958) are reported alongside as a machine replicate; if the CloudPC run is worse this is reported as such, the rule is not revisited.
amendment_3.requested_by: user, 2026-10-15 ('用cloudpc重新跑一下种子3'), after the assistant advised that a plain rerun would be selective; the rule above is what makes it reportable.

amendment_4.written_before: the imitation training of seeds 4 and 5, and before any result of the HomePC seed-2 and CloudPC seed-3 searches
amendment_4.what: seeds 4 and 5 are added to round 2. Imitation: round-1 protocol unchanged (descend.py train, 40 epochs, same teacher traces collect_train/val.npz, seed 4 / 5), blind-tested once (imit_s4, imit_s5, round-1 bench). Gated specs built exactly as prepare() does (gate, tail_s, base_law = law_tuned, upset_law = pulse_tuned, tilt 25 deg). ES: round-2 settings (60 generations, nod+dash, cases_per_task 4); seed 4 searched on CloudPC, seed 5 on HomePC (no CloudPC replicate planned). Selection by amendment 2 on CloudPC, one blind test each.
amendment_4.hypotheses: H1, H1' and H2 now require >= 3 of 5 seeds (seeds 1-5; per seed the primary run of amendment 3). H3 and H4 unchanged.
